title: Inspect an Xcode Build Failure
purpose: Produce and review a cited log-only diagnosis; preserve all unrun checks and forbid automatic repairs.
inputs: Sanitized supplied log with stable line numbers
Optional source excerpt and scheme/toolchain context
outputs: Structured diagnosis matching response.schema.json; no execution claims

verificationCriteria: Each observation quotes an exact supplied log line; hypotheses remain unconfirmed; execution statuses are not-run/not-applied.

expectedArtifacts: Reviewed structured diagnosis and evidence gaps
verificationCriteria: Review citations, dependency/context gaps and proposed next steps; fixture scorer output is not model/runtime evidence.

humanCheckpoint.reason: A person decides whether more inputs or a separately scoped verification is justified.
humanCheckpoint.requiredDecision: Request context or separately authorize a bounded build/test; no automatic fix or signing/account action.
